result.summary: Found 3 issues: duplicate restaurant cards with identical data, truncated restaurant names, and a partially cut-off category chip at the edge.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards side by side with the same image, delivery time, and price, which looks like duplicated or incorrect data.
issues.suggestion: Ensure each card represents a unique restaurant or distinct offer; remove duplicates and load varied nearby options.

issues.description: The third card title is truncated to 'Smash Bros Bu' instead of the full restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or truncate with an ellipsis so the name remains readable and complete.

issues.description: The category filter row ends with a partially visible empty/white chip on the far right, creating a broken edge appearance beyond the expected last labeled chip.
issues.suggestion: Add proper end padding to the horizontal scroller or ensure only fully intended chips are rendered without a stray partial empty pill.
